label: v6_s3_base_l1_s0_ep170_r3_stay_es0
config_content:
# v6 S3 (docs/v6_instructions.md 3.0 "S3: base段(L1)"). Identical to
# config/exp/v5_base_l1.yml except pretrain points at v6_s2_base_mse
# (ep400, docs/v6_experiment_log.md SS30) instead of v5_base_mse, and the
# model is SuperpositionNetworkProbeQV6 (v6's reward-conditioned, FiLM
# critic called with fixed r=A-1's true value, same as S2).
#
# Diff vs config/exp/v5_base_l1.yml (2 lines):
#   model.name : SuperpositionNetworkProbeQ -> SuperpositionNetworkProbeQV6
#   train.pretrain.exp_config : v5_base_mse -> v6_s2_base_mse
# Everything else identical: r3_stay data, decoder-only training (SM/Encoder/
# FPM/probe_critic frozen), 200ep, l1_loss, batch 10, AdamW lr 1e-3 wd 1e-2.
model:
    name: SuperpositionNetworkProbeQV6
    config: default
    mode: ~
runner: PredictionFeaturePredictionRunner
data:
    name: r3_stay
load_state_dict_strict: False
p_mask_vision: 0.99
train:
    loss_function: l1_loss
    pretrain:
        exp_config: v6_s2_base_mse
        seed: 0
        epoch: 400
    batch_size: 10
    max_epochs: 200
    save_interval: 10
    test_interval: 10
    optimizer: AdamW
    optim_config:
        default:
            lr: 0.001
            weight_decay: 0.01
        freeze:
            - superposition_module
            - vision_encoder_module
            - integration_module
            - share_lns
            - feature_prediction_module
            - probe_critic
        per_params:
            - name: bias
              args:
                  weight_decay: 0.0
